## Acceptance scope

1. **Pulse, reserve and recharge form a real choice.** A successful 12-second pulse pays exactly 25 from one eligible cell, diver before controlled hold with stable identity; no fractions pooled or remote charge. Active/boundary/tool/insufficient-charge refusals are atomic. Bench recharge uses real local sources, works before hull ownership and only restores cell charges. Existing reserve-to-hull/service remain distinct. Quiet/cover/retreat do not require charge. UI and rules share authoritative previews and show the paying cell/cost.
2. **Local gathering/crafting/storage is consistent and useful.** Only the actual bench’s locker, local buoy and correctly supported cradle hold count; remote/other-site/berth/transaction sources refuse. Locked workshop stock cannot fund its own restoration. Bulk moves preserve IDs/provenance and whole eligible public material stacks, with all-or-nothing capacity, explicit operands and equipment/module exclusions. Individual transfer remains usable; refusals preserve context/focus. Early ingredient costs and 16/11/12 starter arithmetic fit real stock, bundles, capacity and both early orders without grants.
3. **The Canopy return earns a useful optional refit.** Two crust/two resin yield exactly one retained 2 CU item after C04 and Dart receipt. Installation uses one of two Dart sockets and that hold’s capacity. Quiet target 3→4.2, normal8 unchanged, boost11→9; loudness, pressure and drain per second unchanged. Refusal/locality/occupancy/transaction semantics, disabled-collar removal, intact transfer, salvage/rebuild and loss/reload preserve identity and strict ownership. No duplicate receipt/item, negative capacity or silent deletion. UI distinguishes fabricated/stored/installed and reference prices from historical expenditure.
4. **Compatibility is explicit and safe.** Schema2/content expedition.3 with validated foundation.1 and expedition.2 reads; old-domain guard rejects new trim data disguised as .2. Preserve strict current relationships, original metadata/bytes and repository/session/journal policy. No gifts/refunds/reset on ordinary .2 migration. Immediate Save/Export/Import/Continue remain valid; no downgrade promised. SOL-M1-R4-01 is corrected in new and exactly known old notices without rewriting arbitrary feedback or changing which generation is backed up.
5. **Presentation preserves discovery and critical information.** Only approved opening/C01 hypothesis/C03–04 leads changed; observations/provenance/chronology/placements unchanged. Existing region/landmark leads retain ambiguity and truthful unfinished Basin scope. Clear prep/refit/recharge controls, semantic keyboard focus, warnings/captions-off/unsaved/graphics recovery and separate cell/service concepts. Judge actual pixels and interaction evidence, not only string tests. Existing hunter fins were retained after visual inspection; no audible-mix claim.
6. **Playable evidence supports the bounded batch honestly.** Fresh committed-source New→C01–04→Dart/Canopy→useful return→trim→second quiet approach→safe return→actual reload, durable action counts, reserves and optional-note independence. Separate fresh island-first/hand-food/pre-vehicle recharge, paid pulse under warning, atomic no-charge refusal and labelled quiet-return branch. Inspect the full route’s navigation damage, corrective service, missed boarding, source attribution and fixture limits. Guided routes do not establish blind human learning, duration, preference or optimality.
